workspace-source.alt: The workspace showing the AgriStress-500 dataset as a single card in the lineage graph
workspace-source.caption: A workspace with AgriStress-500 as the only dataset. The screenshots in this guide use a 24-image sample of it so they are quick to reproduce; the full dataset shows 451 samples.

byod-demo.alt: The Bring Your Own Data dialog with the Load Demo choice
byod-demo.caption: Add dataset → Load Demo lists the one-click demos; AgriStress-500 is the one this guide uses.

workspace-lineage.alt: The lineage graph with AgriStress-500 on the left and two tiled sub-datasets connected to it
workspace-lineage.caption: After partitioning: both sub-datasets hang under AgriStress-500. The gray flask means no experiments yet.

panel-statistics.alt: The detail panel of a sub-dataset on the Statistics tab, showing feature distributions
panel-statistics.caption: Statistics: row and column counts, plus a distribution for each numeric feature.

panel-images.alt: The detail panel on the Images tab showing a grid of 256 by 256 field tiles
panel-images.caption: Images: an evenly spaced sample of the dataset. Click a tile to open it full size.

panel-annotations.alt: The detail panel on the Annotations tab showing mask coverage
panel-annotations.caption: Annotations: how much of a sample has segmentation masks, and whether embeddings exist.

merge.alt: Two datasets selected in the graph and the Merge datasets panel on the right
merge.caption: Shift-click two or more datasets, name the result and merge. The union is de-duplicated by image.

explorer.alt: The Visual Explorer with parallel coordinates, a scatter plot and the results table
explorer.caption: The Visual Explorer: parallel coordinates on top, the scatter view and results table below, setup on the right.

preview-image.alt: The image preview showing a field tile
preview-image.caption: Click a point or a table row to preview the tile. Image shows the photograph on its own.

preview-overlay.alt: The image preview on the Overlay tab with the ground-truth mask drawn over the tile
preview-overlay.caption: Overlay draws the ground-truth annotation over the image. The caption confirms it is not a model output.

preview-prediction.alt: The image preview on the Prediction tab with the model's mask drawn over the same tile
preview-prediction.caption: Prediction shows only what the model produced for the same tile, captioned with its epoch.

train-dialog.alt: The Train a model dialog with preset, epochs and split settings
train-dialog.caption: Train model opens this dialog: choose a preset, adjust a few settings and start.

run-live.alt: The Visual Explorer header showing a training run in progress
run-live.caption: While a run trains, its status and progress stay visible in the header.

experiments.alt: The Experiments view listing training runs with their metrics
experiments.caption: Experiments: every run, its status and headline metrics. Select runs to compare them.

run-detail.alt: A run's detail view with loss curves and parameters
run-detail.caption: A run's detail: curves, parameters, tags and artifacts.

run-overlay.alt: The Visual Explorer with a run overlaid, adding loss columns and an epoch scrubber
run-overlay.caption: Overlay a run to add per-image loss columns and scrub through epochs.

save-selection.alt: The Visual Explorer setup panel with the Save selection as a dataset form
save-selection.caption: Save selection as a dataset turns the rows you are looking at into a new node in the lineage graph.

workspace-badges.alt: The lineage graph with a yellow experiment badge on a dataset with a running experiment
workspace-badges.caption: Yellow flask: a run is active. Gray: none. Hover a badge for the counts.

experiments-filtered.alt: The Experiments view filtered to the runs of one dataset
experiments-filtered.caption: View experiments in a dataset's panel opens this list already filtered to that dataset.

byod-choose.alt: The Bring Your Own Data dialog offering Load Demo, Prepare From Server Folder and Create New Dataset
byod-choose.caption: Add dataset offers three routes. This chapter uses the second and third; the first was chapter 3.

byod-folder.alt: The Prepare From Server Folder list showing image sets with their image and label counts
byod-folder.caption: Prepare From Server Folder lists every folder directly under image_sets/ with its image and label counts. Folders already built show Added.

byod-upload.alt: The Create New Dataset form with name, images, annotations and embeddings fields
byod-upload.caption: Create New Dataset: a name, your images (a folder or files), and optionally COCO annotations and an embeddings file.

workspace-own.alt: The workspace with the new my-field-survey dataset selected in the lineage graph and its panel open
workspace-own.caption: The new dataset appears as its own root in the graph. From here everything in chapters 5 to 8 applies.

embeddings-view.alt: The Visual Explorer with the Embeddings source selected, showing a 3D map of images and projection and clustering controls
embeddings-view.caption: With embeddings present, Source → Embeddings shows each image as a point in 3D. Choose PCA, t-SNE or LLE, and colour by ground-truth cluster or K-means.
